info.title: Bridge AI OS Runtime Supplement
info.description: Supplemental live endpoints present in code but not in canonical openapi.json.

get.description:
Drift detection — immune system logic.
Compare current state to baseline mission vector.
If drift > threshold: trigger governanceVote or training (caller responsibility).

post.description: SIWE login: verify signature, check nonce (replay protection), optionally verify on-chain role, issue JWT.

get.description: Capability registry. Twins read flags before acting. Scale to 100 variants.

post.description:
Create new tasks if backlog is low.
Body: { target_backlog?: int, max_create?: int }

get.description: Economic circuit breaker status. When tripped: all economic actions blocked.

post.description:
Reset economic circuit breaker. Orchestrator authority required.
Use after investigating root cause (entropy spike, trade frequency exceeded).

get.description: Global weight vector. State-controlled. score = w · P(task).

post.description: Governance-controlled. Merge with defaults. Valid keys: impact, revenue, risk, latency, trust.

get.description: GET founder objectives. Wallpaper reads this; updates live when objectives met.

patch.description: Mark objective complete. Wallpaper will update on next refresh (run-wallpaper-live.ps1).

post.description: Append data to a Google Spreadsheet

get.description: Get information about a Google Spreadsheet
Read data from a Google Spreadsheet

post.description: Write data to a Google Spreadsheet

get.description:
Composite health score. One number: is the organism stable?
health = (1 - error_rate) × (1 - silence_spike_deviation) × latency_factor × invariant_integrity

post.description: Ingest GOASSL protocol messages into Digital Twin cognition.
Add skills to Digital Twin's skill stack.

get.description: Get ingestion pipeline status.

post.description: Auto-create tasks from external signals into mission board.

get.description:
Map everything: pboots, runbs, state version, services, twins, capabilities, telemetry, wiki.
For orchestration and live display. Poll this or /api/live/report for live display.
Single payload for live display. Report live: map + status. Poll e.g. every 5s for dashboard.

post.description: Complete a task. Payout = _priority_locked * quality. Value-conserving economic loop.

Pledge to an upliftment task.
Accepts optional event_id for idempotency (so clients can retry safely).

get.description:
Orchestrate and direct: list of actions (scripts/commands) to run for sync, audit, wallpaper.
Frontend can display these and user runs them (or a scheduler). No execution from API.

post.description:
Crypto / on-chain payment webhook.
Called by contract_listener or external bridge node.

PayPal webhook endpoint.
Set in PayPal developer dashboard: https://api.bridge-ai-os.tech/api/payments/webhook/paypal

Paystack webhook endpoint.
Set this URL in Paystack dashboard: https://api.bridge-ai-os.tech/api/payments/webhook/paystack

get.description:
Return all registered projects — the single source of truth for the full ecosystem.
Any project or UI can call this to discover the live platform map.

post.description:
Register or update a project in the central registry.
Any project (AOE, Supaco, Taurus, Next.js, etc.) calls this at startup.

Required: { "id": "my-project" }
Optional: label, type, baseUrl, apiUrl, health, port, capabilities, meta, status

get.description: Get a specific registered project by id.

delete.description: Remove a project from the registry.

post.description:
Keep-alive endpoint. Projects call this periodically to report they are online.
Optional body: { "status": "online" | "degraded" | "offline" }

get.description: Registered nodes for mesh discovery.

post.description: Register a node for discovery (node_id, url, capabilities).

get.description: Replication engine status: last run, open_tasks, twin_count, rules_evaluated, twins_created.
Top agents by composite reputation score.
Return latest mouse sensor sample plus lifetime session earnings.

post.description:
Ingest mouse position/activity from mouse-tracker-boot.ps1.
Every 12 active (moved=true) samples a marketplace task is auto-created
and completed, earning the user 0.5 BRDG in the revenue pool.

get.description: Return latest WiFi sensor sample.

post.description: Ingest WiFi RF sample from wifi-rf-boot.ps1. Expects signal, ssid, etc.

get.description: Return all hardcoded skill definitions registered in the system.

post.description:
Fetch full YouTube video metadata and extract a Bridge skill definition.
If save=true, persists the skill definition to memory for the engine + SVG renderer.

get.description: Auto-recommend YouTube tutorials for an existing skill_id.
Search YouTube for skill-related videos. Requires YOUTUBE_API_KEY.
Immutable snapshot. Ties allowed mutation to system identity. SPINE: no rogue mutation.

Full state snapshot. Version without snapshot is memory without recall.
Returns: state, state_version, state_hash, priority_distribution.
Status check - alias for health.
Return last N SVG build log summaries from E:\A\logs for Taurus dashboard.

Swarm Health Index (0–1).
Pulls from currently available runtime signals; degrades gracefully when unknown.
Return full structural mapping: mission, architecture, economic engine, roles, governance, revenue.

post.description: Alignment filter. Returns aligned, reason, confidence, clarification_needed.
Adaptive learning loop: ingest structural change. Requires orchestrator + evolution budget.

get.description: Explain The Bridge at Level 1 (simple), 2 (operational), or 3 (strategic).
Input → Processing → Output → Feedback → Reinforcement.
Twin function, authority boundaries, decision constraints.
Return skill definition for Bridge_System_Comprehension.
Observability: decision_latency, speech_latency, silence_rate, state_mutation_frequency, economic_conversion_rate.

post.description:
Ingest telemetry events (e.g. svg_build_completed) for usage accounting,
treasury, and Taurus dashboard. Events flow to billing/reputation.

get.description: Return last SVG build event for Taurus dashboard.

post.description:
Collect revenue from any project into the unified treasury.
Required: amount (float)
Optional: currency (default BRDG), source_project, method, type, meta

get.description:
Status endpoint for CFO UI to determine whether controls are armed.
This does NOT enable anything; it only reports current policy.

post.description:
Record a treasury disbursement from a bucket.
Required: bucket (ubi|treasury|ops|founder), amount, destination
Optional: authorized_by

get.description: Recent treasury transactions (most recent first). Max 200.
List all supported payment rails and their status.
Full treasury status: totals, buckets, by-project, by-method, by-currency.

Compact treasury snapshot for dashboards and live map.
Full ledger + disbursements at GET /api/treasury/status and GET /api/treasury/ledger.
Check if TTS backend is available (e.g. ElevenLabs configured).
Digital Twin holds env API key status. Call this to get which keys are configured/missing/placeholder. Never returns secret values.

post.description: Allocate top-priority task to twin. No random. No manual override. Execution = argmax(w·P).
Auto-add a random task from the Bridge task pool.
One twin teaches another a skill. Teacher must have the skill verified and sufficient trust.
UBI claim/distribute. Economic risk governor: max exposure, cooldown.

get.description:
Get user settings (shared per user across all domains).
User id from X-User-Id or X-Bridge-User-Id header; otherwise "default".

put.description:
Save user settings (shared per user across all domains).
Body: { "settings": { ... } } or { ... } (whole object as settings).

get.description: Return twin registry if sync-twins-wiki.ps1 has been run. All digital twins + state version + versioned artifacts from C:\Downloads.
Root-level health check for monitoring and node console.
